metaTitle: Peeplet: Daily Puzzles, new boards every morning
metaDescription: Free daily puzzles for Android and iPhone: logic, words and pictures from Easy to Insane, with arcade and versus games. Fresh boards every morning.
lede: A fresh set of boards every morning, the same for everyone. {count} games of logic, words and pictures, from Easy to Insane, with arcade and versus for when one more is never enough.
pillarMorningText: Every daily board changes at midnight and everyone gets the same one, so a win is worth comparing over breakfast.
pillarLevelsText: Four levels on every daily board. Kids settle in on Easy; grown-ups get a proper fight on Insane.
pillarTogetherText: Arcade games for your own time, and versus games against the computer, a friend across the table or someone online.
puzzlesIntro: A fresh board of each, every day, at four levels.
arcadeIntro: Games to come back to, on your own time.
versusIntro: Against the computer, a friend, or someone online.
closeText: Free on Android, in beta on iPhone. In English, Portuguese and Spanish.
madeBy: Made by Hypertradeworx. Ads keep the game free.
